property_summary: For every call to transfer with any non-empty _tos and any callee address, the reference contract always performs all low-level calls for every element of _tos before returning (so a call that completes will only return after all iterations), whereas the mutant may return after the first iteration and thus can return earlier causing observable difference in whether the function completed all calls (we detect this by having the callee record how many calls it received and asserting that after transfer returns the callee saw exactly _tos.length calls).
change_summary: Insert an early unconditional return(true) inside the loop after the first call so function returns true immediately (may change return for some inputs).
